plan.summary: Correct placeholder bylines on live reviews (BRO-3414). "Eric March" is the theaterlife.com WordPress import account shown as post author on every Drupal-imported review; each live page names the real critic in a "By X" line, or carries no byline. theaterscene.net "Archive"/"Unknown" files take the JSON-LD author (matching the URL author slug); New Yorker "Condé Nast" files take the "By X" critic, or Unknown where only the house byline appears. Every page was fetched live on 2026-10-12 and its canonical URL matched the file URL. Also un-glues 9 theaterlife bylines fused to the first word of the article.
steps: Set criticName to the byline printed on each live page
Set Unknown where the page names no critic
Strip the article word glued onto 9 theaterlife bylines
